scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,widget -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:admin" "pnpm dev:widget"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --package cursora-api uvicorn cursora_api.main:create_app --factory --reload --reload-dir apps/api/src --reload-dir packages/features/src --port 8000
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package cursora-api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.test: pnpm test:api && pnpm test:features && pnpm test:ml && pnpm test:widget && pnpm test:admin
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cursora/api-client build && pnpm --filter @cursora/widget build && pnpm --filter @cursora/admin build
scripts.docker:nginx-test: node scripts/compose.mjs prod run --rm --no-deps nginx nginx -t
scripts.ml:notebook: uv run --package cursora-ml --group notebook jupyter lab --notebook-dir ml/notebooks
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm api:check
